findings.evidence: `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/GeneralLinearGroup/Defs.lean:75-84` defines `det` with `@[simps]`, generating `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply : ((det A : Rˣ) : R) = (↑A : Matrix n n R).det`; it is used at `Mathlib/.../Defs.lean:206` and in this repo at `TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/ClassicalGroups/Determinant.lean:138`. `Matrix.eval_det_mvPolynomialX` (`Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/MvPolynomial.lean:80`) produces `det (Matrix.of fun i j => s (i, j))`.
findings.fix: Replace `hval` by `(Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply g).symm`; with it the following six-step coercion chain (`map_one, ← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, ← Units.val_mul, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add`) can largely collapse into one `simp [← Units.val_mul, ← zpow_add]`. At line 142 close with `simp [Matrix.of_apply]` (or `congr`) rather than `rfl`.
findings.issue: `have hval : (g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) k).det = ((Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det g : kˣ) : k) := rfl` is undocumented defeq across the `Units` coercion. The same class appears at line 141-142, where `rw [entryEval, detPoly, Matrix.eval_det_mvPolynomialX]` is followed by a bare `rfl` closing `det (Matrix.of fun i j => (↑g) i j) = det ↑g` through the `Matrix.of` wrapper and eta.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/Intertwining.lean:84`: `lemma isIntertwining (f : IntertwiningMap ρ σ) (g : G) (v : V) : f (ρ g v) = σ g (f v)`. After `rw [← hw]` the goal is `σ g (f w) = f (ρ g w)`.
findings.fix: Replace the `simpa` line with `exact (f.isIntertwining g w).symm`.
findings.issue: `hfg` is proved by `simpa using (LinearMap.congr_fun (f.isIntertwining' g) w).symm`, reaching into the primed structure field (a `∘ₗ` equation) and relying on `simp` to unfold the composition, when the public API lemma states the goal verbatim.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/ToLin.lean:671-672`: `theorem LinearMap.toMatrix_mulVec_repr (f : M₁ →ₗ[R] M₂) (x : M₁) : LinearMap.toMatrix v₁ v₂ f *ᵥ v₁.repr x = v₂.repr (f x)`, which entrywise is `b.repr (ρ g w) p = ∑ l, toMatrix b b (ρ g) p l * b.repr w l`.
findings.fix: Derive `hexp` from `LinearMap.toMatrix_mulVec_repr b b (ρ g) w`: take `congr_fun ... p`, unfold `Matrix.mulVec`/`dotProduct` and commute the factors, e.g. `simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, mul_comm] using congr_fun (LinearMap.toMatrix_mulVec_repr b b (ρ g) w) p`.
findings.issue: `hexp` reproves a Mathlib lemma by hand: `conv_lhs => rw [← b.sum_repr w]` followed by a seven-lemma `simp only [map_sum, map_smul, Finsupp.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply, Finsupp.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]`. This is exactly the brittle unfolding chain the rubric warns about, and it hides that the fact is already available.

findings.evidence: Lines 524-530 and 538-545 differ only in the trailing `mul_mem` witness; `toMatrix_mem_of_toMatrix_mem` (line 352) and `toMatrix_mem_of_toMatrix_mem_of_surjective` (line 317) are already abstracted over `A` for the same reason.
findings.fix: Add a subalgebra-generic companion next to `toMatrix_tprod`, e.g. `theorem toMatrix_tensorProduct_mem (A : Subalgebra k (G → k)) (hb : ∀ p l, (fun g => toMatrix b b (ρ g) p l) ∈ A) (hc : ∀ p l, (fun g => toMatrix c c (σ g) p l) ∈ A) (i j) : (fun g => toMatrix (b.tensorProduct c) (b.tensorProduct c) ((ρ.tprod σ) g) i j) ∈ A`, and have both `tprod` lemmas instantiate it at `polynomialFunctions ℂ n` / `rationalFunctions ℂ n`.
findings.issue: `IsPolynomialRep.tprod` (lines 524-528) and `IsRationalRep.tprod` (lines 538-542) contain a verbatim-identical `hentry`/`funext` block; only the final membership witness differs. The file already established the right factoring for this — `toMatrix_mem_of_toMatrix_mem` is stated over an arbitrary `Subalgebra k (G → k)` precisely so both properties reuse one entry computation — but the tensor-product case does not follow it.

summary: Three proofs lean on undocumented definitional equality or bypass existing API: a `rfl` across the `Units` coercion where `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply` exists (and is already used in this directory), a `simpa` through the raw `isIntertwining'` field where `IntertwiningMap.isIntertwining` states the goal, and a hand-rolled `simp only` chain reproving `LinearMap.toMatrix_mulVec_repr`. The two `tprod` proofs also duplicate an entry computation the file's own subalgebra-generic pattern would factor out.
